title: Hruday uniform local closeness of all AQ-type subsequential states and the boundary-independent first-order density
accepted: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (model AQ_patterned_zero_selected: SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0) with Haar product reference P_R, 21 omitted faces per anchor entering as -(tau/3)W_f in normalized units delta=alpha/8; both signs |tau|<=10^-8; cover R={0,e_z} of the original xz Wilson loop, 48 links, 36 endpoints, 7 incident anchors; observable class B(H_R); common clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar), with the two named construction families F1 = centered whole-star boxes Lambda_N (AQ1) and F2 = all-contained-face boxes with padding (I1 section 6) on the same Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N>=2: (1) both families satisfy the AV1 premises: F1 by the admitted chain I1 -> AM2 -> AQ1/AQ2 -> AV1 -> AW1; F2 item by item (anchor groups of the retained faces supported in (b+S) cap Lambda_N, |X|<=4, termination order 8, per-site sum J<=28|tau|=J_0=7/25000000 at the cap with J_0G(R)<37/6250000<1/64 and 2J_0G'(R)<77/390625<1, at most 49 first-order faces per site, cutoff-vector removal, reset omega(h_R)<=98|tau| and C_F=56|tau||F|, local trace-norm compactness and a diagonal extraction of its own); F2 retains 28N(5N+1) boundary faces more than F1, and both retain the same 82 faces meeting R for N>=2; states are compared in the trace norm on B(H_R), and dynamics is named in the norm on compact time windows with no dynamical statement. (2)-(3) For every pair of subsequential limits of the named construction families F1 and F2 at the same coupling, on the fixed cover R and for the frozen observable class, the reduced densities satisfy ||rho_R - rho'_R||_1 <= 2D and agree to first order in tau; this does not assert equality of the states, whole-sequence convergence, translation invariance, boundary independence of the dynamics, or a rate in N. Constants: 2D=1170159676931825184288274812132100/42981220507576537932303142777593983768257 (~2.72249057405e-8; D=585079838465912592144137406066050/42981220507576537932303142777593983768257 the AV1 gate forward tier (ii)), meeting the preregistered 1/1250000 with margin ~29.38 (tier (i) 2D_i~4.736e-5 fails and is retained); the common first-order density is rho^(1)_R=(tau/72) sum_{f in F_R}(|W_f Omega_R><Omega_R|+|Omega_R><W_f Omega_R|) over the 10 faces F_R with owner set exactly R (xz r=0,1,2, s=0,1 and yz r=0..3, s=0, anchored at 0; the 72 straddling faces among the 82 meeting R have zero R-marginal and the family has no single-site creations), with ||rho^(1)_R||_1=sqrt(10)|tau|/72 (~4.39205e-10 at the cap) and Tr(rho^(1)_R W)=+tau/144 (AW1); for every subsequential limit of either family ||rho_R-P_R-rho^(1)_R||_1<=K_2' tau^2 with the R-local trace-norm constant K_2'=966771578474926086618624139557778885954947547760216752246561/72052885697817210754545804931891200000000000000000000000 (~13417.5275439; items 4rho+2T(72a+2rho)+2(33a+rho)^2+2eps_R^2+20a eps_R^2, a=|tau|/144, T=(49a)/(1-352J), rho=352JT, eps_R=82a+2rho+(33a+rho)^2), so any two such limits satisfy ||rho_R-rho'_R||_1<=2K_2' tau^2=966771578474926086618624139557778885954947547760216752246561/360264428489086053772729024659456000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (~2.68350550879e-12). K_2' exceeds the AW1 constant K_2^+=81108864767825329926713064490531229475390625/24176936535511801466930759024724079017984 (~3354.80322946) by the factor ~3.99950, because K_2^+ bounds the single observable W while K_2' bounds the full trace norm on B(H_R); with the admitted AM2 remainder, a trace-norm constant built from the AW1 items is at least 2rho/tau^2~6708.2. Each statement holds for a chosen subsequential limit of either family, every one separately; it is uniform local closeness and not uniqueness. A quantitative boundary comparison here means this closeness bound plus the matching first-order term; it is not a variational statement about which boundary condition the infinite-volume theory selects. Every constant is uniform in N at fixed spacing and fixed tau and is not uniform in the lattice spacing a. The -tau values replay the same |tau| formula. Uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence, a rate in N, translation invariance, boundary independence of the dynamics, a dynamical, continuum or weak-coupling statement and scientific priority are not admitted.
limitations: Only the zero-selected patterned family (selected triple (0,0,0), Haar reference), the cover R={0,e_z}, fixed spacing and |tau|<=10^-8, with the two named families on centered cubes Lambda_N, N>=2; nothing transfers to literal vertex boxes (I1 section 7), periodic or orthant boxes, nonzero selected triples, the uniform route-B model (its K_2 was not transferred in AX1), weak coupling or the continuum

Uniform local closeness on the fixed region R at the same coupling, not uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence, a rate in N, translation invariance or boundary independence of the dynamics; two limits may differ by up to 2K_2' tau^2 on R and without bound elsewhere; 2D alone also bounds states at different couplings (P_R is tau-independent), so the boundary-comparison content is the matching first-order term
The first-order density is a statement about a coefficient through the uniform remainder bound, not a tau-derivative of a subsequential limit (subsequences depend on tau)

K_2' is an upper bound dominated (99.99%) by the generic AM2 majorant 4rho and exceeds K_2^+ (~3.9995x); the contract's '(not the whole-box K_2^+)' is read as 'built from R-local face pins', not as a smaller constant; labelled variants (sqrt-2 sectors ~9487.945, 288-majorant ~10978.18, both ~7763.06, admitted-eps ~13417.81) are valid, not headline

Supplementary two-sided observation sqrt(10)|tau|/72 -/+ K_2' tau^2, i.e. ||rho_R-P_R||_1 in [4.3786e-10, 4.4055e-10] for every limit of either family: a labelled observation only, not a contract target, not an admitted tier and not a resolved interaction shift; it does not replace D

Inherited without re-proof: AM2 majorant, fixed point, excited-sector exclusion and cutoff passage (applied to F2 through their hypotheses); AV1 product split and cutoff-vector removal; AQ1 compactness, diagonal extraction and Nachtergaele-Sims dynamics (named only); AW1 c^(1) and outside-excitation lemma; the I1 dictionary; Peter-Weyl/Haar orthogonality, Uhlmann/Fuchs-van de Graaf and Nachtergaele-Sims cited, not machine-checked

Independence limited to proof routes, enumeration and code: the forward-only premises (triage goal-4 note, Jung loop-2 notes) and the shared contract, selection note and AV1/AW1 reports and reviews state the mechanism; the Jung sentence form reached the reverse through its task prompt, and the reverse saw two forward file names; isolation is verified for repository inputs only; all agents are correlated model agents

Producer checkers do not pin every exported value: the forward supplementary lower end and sqrt-2 rounding direction and the reverse 82/72 ledger pins ran silently when edited and were caught only by the skeptic validator; AY2 should read 2D, K_2' and 2K_2' tau^2 from this gate as exact rationals
The -tau evaluation is a replay of the same |tau| formula (rho^(1)_R is odd under the AW1 flip), not a second confirmation
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AQ_patterned_zero_selected) at both signs |tau|<=10^-8; two named construction families F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes and F2 = I1 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N>=2; cover R={0,e_z}; observable class B(H_R); trace norm on R for states, norm on compact time windows named for dynamics; common clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar
decision: Admit, for every pair of subsequential limits of F1 and F2 at the same tau: (1) both families satisfy the AV1 premises (F2 item by item with the same J_0=7/25000000, per-site sum 28|tau|, supports |X|<=4, termination order 8, reset 98|tau| on R, local trace-norm compactness); (2) ||rho_R-rho'_R||_1 <= 2D with 2D = 1170159676931825184288274812132100/42981220507576537932303142777593983768257 (about 2.7225e-8; D is the AV1 forward tier (ii) bound), meeting 1/1250000 with margin about 29.4; tier (i) 2D_i about 4.74e-5 fails and is retained; (3) the common first-order reduced density rho^(1)_R = (tau/72) sum over the 10 faces with owner set exactly R of (|W_f Omega_R><Omega_R| + h.c.), trace norm sqrt(10)|tau|/72, Tr(rho^(1)_R W)=+tau/144, identical for every subsequential limit of either family (72 of the 82 faces meeting R drop out under the R-marginal); (4) the R-local trace-norm constant K_2' = 966771578474926086618624139557778885954947547760216752246561/72052885697817210754545804931891200000000000000000000000 (about 13417.53) with ||rho_R-rho'_R-0||_1 <= 2K_2' tau^2 (about 2.68e-12) after subtracting the common first-order density. Bind the triangle values common to the forward, the reverse and the skeptic pre-comparison; the Bures pairwise constant, the sqrt(2), 288-majorant and combined K_2' variants are labelled refinements only. Recorded finding: K_2' is about 4.0 times K_2^+ (about 3354.80), not smaller, because K_2' bounds the trace norm over all of B(H_R) while K_2^+ bounds the single observable W and the AM2 remainder dominates both; the contract's 'not the whole-box K_2^+' is read as 'built from R-local face counts'. Recorded as a labelled observation only (not an admitted tier, not a replacement for D, not an interaction shift): ||rho_R-P_R||_1 in [4.3786e-10, 4.4055e-10] for every limit of either family; AY2 may certify it under its own contract. Recorded non-blocking: the reverse's 'derivative of the fidelity identity' holds in vector form only (the scalar derivative vanishes); the two producers use different valid padding conventions; the reverse does not export rate_in_N_claimed (closeness_order [1,2] adopted); reverse isolation holds for repository files, and the Jung sentence wording reached the reverse through its task prompt (disclosed); the forward's wording defects W1-W7 (K_2^+ is volume-uniform and W-specific; 'uniqueness of the AQ state' quoted only in negated code spans; rate_claimed and rate_in_N_claimed both exported; state_provenance names F1 only; F2 box geometry read as the same Lambda_N; 'freeze; byte-identical replays' are not control ids). This is uniform local closeness on a fixed region at fixed coupling: no uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence, translation invariance, rate in N, boundary independence of dynamics, continuum or priority statement is admitted. Select AY2 next.
